definitions.explanation: A firm yellow block of herring eggs, salted or preserved in brine and soaked before eating. It has a distinctive crunch and is a fixture of the New Year's {御節|おせち} box.

examples.japanese: {数|かず}の{子|こ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数|かず}の{子|こ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We eat herring roe at New Year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いて→抜く：02384_nuku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧につける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{数|かず}の{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歯|は}ごたえ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧。
examples.english: Soaking out the salt and then steeping it in dashi brings out the crunch of the herring roe.

notes:
The name comes from {鰊|かど}, an old word for herring: {鰊|かど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ became かずのこ, later written with ⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数|かず}の{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塩抜|しおぬ}き→塩抜き：12163_shionuki⟧: soaking the salt out of herring roe
- ⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧{数|かず}の{子|こ}: pre-seasoned herring roe
- {数|かず}の{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歯|は}ごたえ: the crunch of herring roe

CULTURAL NOTE:
- In the New Year's {御節|おせち} box it stands for fertility and many descendants, since one block holds countless eggs. It sits alongside ⟦{黒豆|くろまめ}→黒豆：30552_kuromame⟧ (black beans, for health) and ⟦{田作|たづく}り→田作り：30553_tazukuri⟧ (candied sardines, for a good harvest) as one of the three classic ⟦{祝|いわ}い{肴|ざかな}→祝い肴：30554_iwaizakana⟧.
